name: jengo/notifications
description: Enterprise-grade multi-channel notification engine for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework. Supports transactional responsive Email, regional & global SMS (Twilio and Africa's Talking with link embedding), In-App Database alerts with action links, Push notifications (WebPush & FCM), Webhooks, Slack, and real-time SSE/WebSocket broadcasting.

facade.description: Primary static entry point providing fluent notification dispatching, on-demand routing, immediate execution, and testing fakes.

methods.send: Notification::send(mixed $notifiables, Notification $notification): void (dispatches notification, auto-queueing if ShouldQueue)
methods.route: Notification::route(string $channel, mixed $route): AnonymousNotifiable (creates on-demand ad-hoc recipient)
methods.fake: Notification::fake(): NotificationFake (intercepts all notifications for zero-cost testing)

notifiable.description: Applied to Entities or Models to enable direct notification dispatching and in-app database alert management.

methods.notifications: $user->notifications(?int $limit = null, int $offset = 0): array (returns all in-app notifications)

notifiable.usage: class User extends BaseEntity { use Notifiable; }

contracts.name: ShouldQueue
contracts.description: Marker interface indicating that notifications should be pushed to background workers via codeigniter4/queue.

contracts.name: ChannelInterface
contracts.description: Contract for delivery channels implementing send(object $notifiable, Notification $notification): mixed.

contracts.name: SmsDriverInterface
contracts.description: Contract for custom SMS drivers implementing send(string $to, SmsMessage $message): string|bool.

contracts.name: PushDriverInterface
contracts.description: Contract for custom Push notification drivers implementing send(string|array $target, PushMessage $message): bool|array.

queuing.description: Native asynchronous queuing built on codeigniter4/queue. Notifications implementing ShouldQueue are serialized and pushed to background workers.

properties.delay: public ?int $delay = null; (delay in seconds before worker execution)

queuing.usage: class OrderShipped extends Notification implements ShouldQueue { public ?string $queue = 'emails'; }

entities.description: BaseEntity representation of an in-app database notification with built-in accessors and action helpers.

methods.read: read(): bool (checks if notification has been read)
methods.unread: unread(): bool (checks if notification is unread)
methods.markAsRead: markAsRead(): static (sets read_at timestamp and persists update)
methods.markAsUnread: markAsUnread(): static (clears read_at timestamp and persists update)
methods.title: title(): ?string (retrieves notification title from payload)
methods.level: level(): string (returns alert severity: info, success, warning, error)

models.description: CodeIgniter 4 Model for querying and persisting records in the notifications table.

messages.description: Fluent builder for mobile-responsive HTML emails with inline styles, bulletproof buttons, tables, and callouts.
Fluent builder for SMS alerts supporting sender IDs and embedded URL links.
methods: link(string $url, ?string $label = null): static (embeds or appends clickable action link)

messages.description: DTO for in-app notifications with action links, levels, and icons.
DTO for WebPush and Firebase Cloud Messaging alerts.
DTO for Slack Webhook notifications and Block Kit layouts.
DTO for custom HTTP webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 request signing.
DTO for real-time SSE / WebSocket alerts via jengo/broadcasting.

channels.name: mail
channels.description: Dispatches transactional emails via CodeIgniter 4 email service with inline CSS templates.

channels.name: database
channels.description: Stores notifications in the database table with action links and read/unread status.

channels.name: sms
channels.description: Routes SMS messages to configured driver (Twilio, Africa's Talking, Log, Null).

channels.name: push
channels.description: Delivers push notifications via WebPush (VAPID) or Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM v1).

channels.name: slack
channels.description: Posts formatted messages and Block Kit elements to Slack Incoming Webhook URLs.

channels.name: webhook
channels.description: Delivers secure JSON webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

channels.name: broadcast
channels.description: Broadcasts real-time events to client WebSockets or SSE channels via jengo/broadcasting.

sms.name: africas_talking
sms.description: Africa's Talking SMS API driver with E.164 normalization and alphanumeric sender ID.

sms.name: twilio
sms.description: Twilio REST API driver for global SMS delivery.

sms.name: log
sms.description: Writes SMS messages to application log file for development and inspection.

sms.name: null
sms.description: Silently discards SMS messages for tests.

push.name: fcm
push.description: Google Firebase Cloud Messaging v1 HTTP API driver.

push.name: webpush
push.description: Pure-PHP VAPID Web Push protocol driver.

push.name: log
push.description: Writes push notifications to application log file.

push.name: null
push.description: Silently discards push notifications for tests.

events.name: notifications.sending
events.description: Triggered before a notification is dispatched on a specific channel. Allows listeners to halt or inspect.

events.name: notifications.sent
events.description: Triggered after a notification is successfully sent across a channel. Carries recipient, notification, and channel response.

events.name: notifications.failed
events.description: Triggered when delivery on a channel throws an exception. Carries the captured Throwable instance.

helpers.name: notify
helpers.description: Dispatch a notification to one or multiple notifiables.

helpers.name: notification
helpers.description: Get NotificationManager instance or start an on-demand notification.

commands.name: make:notification <name> [--queue]
commands.description: Generate a new Jengo notification class with optional queueing.

commands.name: notifications:table
commands.description: Generate a migration file for the notifications database table.

commands.name: notifications:test <channel> <recipient>
commands.description: Send a test notification across a specified channel to verify credentials.

installers.description: Publishes app/Config/Notifications.php and scaffolds notifications table migration.
